words: Okay, so on this one, yes, correct. We also need to have a good process for offboarding and archiving sessions and deleting keys. I think I've already answered this, right? Yeah.
answers: Page 5 of decisions.b's briefing ('Five answers that need your own words': asks 21, 22, 25, 28, 29), which Dinis pasted; all five were already answered in records 2026-11-23__asks-2-to-21 and 2026-11-23__asks-22-to-32.
decision: Those answers stand, as recorded. New: the agents write a good process for offboarding: archiving an agent's sessions, retiring its key entry, revoking its signed links, and deleting its key copies. conductor.b drafts it with security.b's review and brings it to Dinis; it changes nothing until he approves it.
